claims: Earth Day is celebrated annually on April 22.
The first Earth Day was in 1970.
The first Earth Day in 1970 launched the modern environmental movement.
The 2026 Earth Day theme is “Our Power, Our Planet.”
Earth Day is the largest secular, civic event in the world focused on environmental protection.
Senator Gaylord Nelson and Harvard student Denis Hayes initiated Earth Day in 1970.
Planting trees is a common Earth Day activity.
Cleaning up litter is a common Earth Day activity.
Using eco-friendly products is a common Earth Day activity.
Attending educational events is a common Earth Day activity.
